name: nmap
description: Network discovery and security auditing toolkit with comprehensive scanning capabilities

ncat.description: Nmap's network Swiss Army knife for connectivity and data transfer
ncat.usage:
ncat -l 8080
ncat example.com 80
ncat --broker --listen 8080
ncat --ssl example.com 443
echo 'GET / HTTP/1.0' | ncat example.com 80

nmap.description: Network reconnaissance engine with NSE scripts for deep service enumeration and OS fingerprinting
nmap.usage:
nmap -sS -O target.com
nmap --script vuln target.com
nmap -sV --script discovery target.com
nmap -p- --min-rate 10000 target.com

npcap-installer.description: Packet capture library installer for Windows network packet analysis

npcap-helper.description: Helper utility for managing Npcap driver installation and configuration

nping.description: Advanced ping utility with custom packet crafting and network troubleshooting capabilities

wlan-helper.description: Wireless network helper utility for WiFi adapter management and configuration
